'''Palkell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] he resided inside [[Gorma-Koss]] in the [[Gormak Lands]] beyond [[Outpost Skyline]], where he was attacked and killed by an individual affiliated with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Engineer Palkell appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the mission "Gormak War Camps" on Voss.
